thread:
Ryan: Heads-up — planning a release tonight 22:00 UTC for runtime v2.7.3, api v1.12.0, console v0.9.4 and edge-router v3.1.0. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Router introduces a handshake header (X-RW-CTX) that needs a quick cross-service check. Need sign-offs for staged rollout and rollback criteria.

Jess: Noted. Can you drop the compatibility matrix + minimal migration steps here? Console will need a feature-flag toggle for the header until SDKs are updated.

Ryan: Compat matrix (short):
```
runtime v2.7.3 -> api v1.12.0 (schema v1.12)
api v1.12.0 -> router v3.1.0 (expects X-RW-CTX optional until 2026-04-05)
console v0.9.4 -> runtime v2.7.3 (needs feature flag for new header)
```
Also note: router falls back to legacy handshake if header missing. Migration steps: update api, then runtime, then router handshake, then console flag flip.

Nikhil: QA ran smoke + perf. Found one intermittent 503 from router when KV lookup latency >3s during synthetic traffic. Filed RW-1123 and added a temporary fallback suggestion: keep legacy handshake enabled for first 15m of rollout. Link: https://issue/REDWOOD/RW-1123

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @Ryan — start=2026-03-21T22:00:00Z, window=1h, stages=[5%,25%,100%]. Steps:
```
./deploy/scripts/rollout.sh --manifest manifest://runtime@2.7.3
./deploy/scripts/rollout.sh --manifest manifest://api@1.12.0
./deploy/scripts/rollout.sh --manifest manifest://router@3.1.0 --staged
```
Rollback plan attached to release notes.

Maria: Ops will be on pager for the window. Suggest: progressive shift 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~20m with a 5m hold between steps. Also recommend pinning console to previous manifest if header mismatches surface.

Jess: I'll add release notes and mark X-RW-CTX as a short-lived deprecation warning. SDK updates are in a small patch, but feature flags needed for customers.

Ryan: Decision summary: Proceed with staged rollout. Safety gates: error rate >1.5x baseline for 5m OR p95 latency +200ms triggers immediate rollback. If rollback triggered, rollback router to v3.0.9 first, keep runtime pinned until verified. Console flag remains off during rollback. We will keep legacy handshake enabled for the first 15 minutes as a safety hedge.

ops-bot: Runbook: https://runbook/internal/router-handshake-migration. Oncall: @Maria on pager, escalation to @Ryan.

deploy-bot: Canary 1 (5%) started. Logs:
```
[deploy-bot] canary-1: router v3.1.0 -> OK
[deploy-bot] canary-1: api v1.12.0 -> OK
[deploy-bot] canary-1: runtime v2.7.3 -> OK
```

Nikhil: Observed a small p95 spike (~+80ms) at 5% but below threshold. No errors aside from one KV-induced 503 from earlier pattern. OK to proceed.

Jess: Console showed a schema warning for a debug field in canary — toggled the feature flag off for canary traffic.

Ryan: Flag toggled. Proceed to 25% in 5m, watcher on p95 and error-rate.

deploy-bot: 25% rollout complete. No new service-level errors reported.

Maria: Ops sign-off: metrics look stable, lifting the manual hold to proceed to 100% after 10m of observation.

deploy-bot: 100% rollout complete. Post-release checks: all services green, no increased error budget consumption.

Ryan: Release finished. Release notes (final): https://changelog/internal/2026-03-21-runtime-2.7.3. Action items: follow-up to remove legacy handshake default on 2026-04-05 and bump SDKs. Closing thread. :tada:
